00043 ChainBaseUGenInternal::ChainBaseUGenInternal(UGen const& input, const int size, const int numChannels) throw()
00044 :   ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(1, numChannels-1),
00045     size_(size),
00046     bufferData(new float*[numChannels]),
00047     chain(UGenArray(size_))
00048 {
00049     inputs[Input] = input;
00050 }
00051 
00052 ChainBaseUGenInternal::~ChainBaseUGenInternal()
00053 {
00054     delete [] bufferData;
00055 }
00056 
00057 void ChainBaseUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00058 {   
00059     const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();  
00060     const int numChannels = getNumChannels();
00061     for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00062     {
00063         bufferData[channel] = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00064     }
00065     
00066     const int sizeMinusOne = size_ - 1;
00067     for(int link = 0; link < sizeMinusOne; link++)
00068     {
00069         chain[link].prepareForBlock(numSamplesToProcess, blockID);
00070         chain[link].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, -1);
00071     }
00072     
00073     UGen& last = chain.last();
00074     last.prepareForBlock(numSamplesToProcess, blockID);
00075     last.setOutputs(bufferData, numSamplesToProcess, numChannels);
00076     last.processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, -1);
00077 }
